items.title_en: Man dubbed ‘America’s Nostradamus’ shares chilling prediction about the world before 2028
items.title_zh: 被称为“美国诺查丹玛斯”的男子对 2028 年之前的世界做出了令人不寒而栗的预测
items.summary_en: A man dubbed ‘America’s Nostradamus’ has shared a chilling prediction that we could see nuclear attacks, a 27-year-long war, and economic collapse all within the next couple of years. John Hogue has spent years analysing ancient predictions from Michel de Nostre-Dame, better known as Nostradamus , and has written several books on the subject, including Nostradamus: The New Revelations and The Millennium Book of Prophecy, 1000 for 2000: Startling Predictions for the New Millennium . Hogue said his own predictions…
items.summary_zh: 一位被称为“美国诺查丹玛斯”的人做出了一个令人不寒而栗的预测：我们可能会在未来几年内看到核袭击、长达 27 年的战争和经济崩溃。约翰·霍格 (John Hogue) 花了数年时间分析米歇尔·德·诺斯特雷达姆 (Michel de Nostre-Dame)（更为人所知的诺查丹玛斯）的古代预言，并就此主题撰写了多本书籍，包括《诺查丹玛斯：新启示录》和《千年预言书》、《2000 年的 1000 年：新千年的惊人预测》

items.title_en: It's illegal to die in these 10 places, and there are strict reasons why
items.title_zh: 死在这10个地方是违法的，有严格的理由
items.summary_en: Most of us don't really know when we're going to die. But if we did, there are certainly some places we'd avoid going when the Grim Reaper comes knocking. That's because there are actually several places around the world where it is illegal to die. You read that right...
items.summary_zh: 我们大多数人都不知道自己什么时候会死。但如果我们这样做了，当死神来敲门时，我们肯定会避免去一些地方。那是因为世界上实际上有几个地方死亡是非法的。你没看错……
